cause: A migration file or spec could not be parsed.
Two migration files share a version.
A file or directory could not be read or written.
An applied migration’s file was edited.
A ledger row has no migration file.
A migration failed and was rolled back.
A migration in the down range has an operation with no inverse.
A table’s CREATE TABLE could not be parsed for a rebuild.
Rows in a table up or plan would rebuild name no parent row.
drop_foreign_key named a key the table does not have.
A create_trigger’s name or table differs from its statement.
A dropped column is used by another object.
An operation that needs a table rebuild is not first in its migration.
A snapshot could not be written, so the step did not run.
new named an object that is not in schema.json.
